verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt is live at developer.nvidia.com/llms.txt, describing NVIDIA's developer portal. Some developer pages also resolve as Markdown (e.g., video-codec-sdk.md and ai-inference.md are cited sources), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs covering this GPU's software stack. However, coverage is inconsistent: cuda-toolkit.md returns 404 and no OpenAPI spec exists. Missing for 10: product-specific llms.txt or agent docs for the RTX PRO 6000 itself, consistent Markdown versions across key docs such as the CUDA Toolkit, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.
